How it works

Four steps, and one thing we refuse to do

The refusal first: we do not show you a business we have not looked at. That makes Getclient smaller than the directories that scrape listings, and it is the entire point.

Search or browse

Start from a category, a city, or the search box. Category and city pages load fast and are indexed by search engines the same way a client would find them.

Read the verification record

Every profile carries a five-item ledger: identity, CIPC registration, insurance, trading history and client ratings. Each item says checked or not checked. Nothing is implied.

Request a quote

Send a structured brief. It goes to the business and it is logged. If they never reply, that shows up in their published response rate.

Rate the work

After the job, give the business a rating out of five. Stars only, one rating per person per business.

Questions

Is Getclient free for people looking to hire?

Yes. There is no charge and no account needed to search, browse or request a quote.

How do you make money?

Businesses pay a monthly subscription for verification and placement. We take no commission on any job.

What does "verified" actually mean here?

It means specific checks were run and passed on a specific date, and each one is listed on the profile. It is not a quality rating.

What is the Listed on Getclient badge?

Every listed business shows it on its own website. Click it on any site and you land on that business’s record here, so you can see exactly what was checked.

Can a business pay to remove a bad rating?

No. Ratings are stars only and cannot be removed by the business.

Do you cover the whole of South Africa?

All nine provinces. Coverage is deepest in the metros and thinner in smaller towns, and the page counts show you exactly how thin.
